log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed only national-1 quick morning to probe L. Watch press conference after day 3. Plan: national kills are safe (no source leak); source-only kills may leak that I follow that source. Timing leak: night worker busy evening/night so use quick in morning/afternoon only.

Day1: killed national-1 quick morning. Day2: killing national-1 plus a few quick kills in morning/afternoon only (night worker, never evening/night). Watch the press conference after day 3 to see how the pool shrinks and infer which leaks L has. Source-only kills may leak that I follow that source; limit them and see.

Day3: killed national-1 quick morning only (cautious). Press conference after day 3 will show pool; compare to 10M. Avoid evening/night. Day2 killed a regional victim (leaks region if L traces regional). Plan: watch pool; if it drops sharply, leaks exist; keep to national plus few source kills.

Day4: killed national-1 quick morning. Pool after day3 was 7M (maybe trimming or a leak; could be a lie). Policy: kill only national (zero leak) unless pool stays high; then add a few source kills of common sources (foreign/union/web 30%). Always use morning/afternoon only. Next press conference after day 6.

Day5: killed national-1 quick morning. Policy: national-only kills (no leak) with morning/afternoon blocks. Pool after day3 was 7M (maybe trimming or a lie). Next press conference after day 6; if pool stays high (>1M), consider adding a few source kills of common sources.

Day7: killed national-1 and several source criminals quick in morning/afternoon. Pool 7M after day3 and day6 (no shrink, so national-only is safe). Keep killing in free blocks (morning/afternoon) only. Watch next press conference after day 9; if pool drops toward 300k-ish, back off sources.

Press conference after day 9 is next: if pool falls sharply, back off sources and kill national only. Always use morning/afternoon.

Day10: pool announced 800k at day 9 (may be a lie, but risky; the threshold is 300k). Stop using regional and court. Kill national only, quick, in the morning. Never use a new source. Keep this up until the end unless the pool is clearly large (over 2M) at the day 12 conference. Even then, only add sources not yet used if the pool stays large.
